summary: Tested the redesigned Live Scoring Screen (EnhancedLiveStatsEntry.js) for desktop and mobile layouts. Verified header buttons, table/card layouts, Shot dropdown functionality, and GameStatsView OF+/OF- columns implementation.

desktop_live_scoring_table_layout.details: Table layout renders correctly with all columns: Act, #, Player, Pos, Shot, Shots, Goals, Assists, Pts, Faceoffs, GBalls, PIM

desktop_shot_button_per_row.details: Each player row has a yellow 'Shot' button that opens the Goal/Save/Miss dropdown

desktop_plus_minus_controls.details: +/- controls present for Assists, Faceoffs, GBalls columns

mobile_card_layout.details: Card-based layout appears on mobile (<768px). Each player card shows: checkbox, jersey number, name, large SHOT button, read-only stats row (S/G/Pts/PIM), and adjustable stats with +/- (Ast/FO/GB)

mobile_shot_button_in_cards.details: Large SHOT button present in each player card

header_team_shot_buttons_size.details: Team SHOT buttons are h-12 w-12 on mobile (48x48px), h-14 w-14 on desktop (56x56px)

header_pen_to_buttons_size.details: Pen/TO buttons are h-6 (24px) on both mobile and desktop, which is larger than previously (h-5 was 20px)

shot_dropdown_functionality.details: Shot dropdown shows correctly with MISS, SAVE, GOAL options, Player dropdown, and Time display

inactive_players_mobile.details: Inactive players show compact info on mobile with checkbox, #, name, and G/A stats

inactive_players_desktop.details: Inactive players show as table rows on desktop with all columns (dimmed styling)

gamestatsview_of_plus_minus_columns.details: OF+ and OF- columns are implemented correctly in GameStatsView.js. They only appear when game_events contain goal events with metadata.playersOnField data. Test game (Eagles vs Hawks) did not have playersOnField data so columns did not appear.

data_testids_verified.stats-tab-box: EXISTS in code - Box Score tab

critical_code_review_comments: EnhancedLiveStatsEntry.js properly implements responsive design with md: breakpoint for mobile/desktop switching
Team SHOT buttons correctly sized at h-12 w-12 (mobile) and h-14 w-14 (desktop) - larger than before
Pen/TO buttons now h-6 (24px) instead of previous h-5 (20px)
GameStatsView OF+/OF- columns correctly conditional on playersOnField metadata existence
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Scoring Screen redesign verified. Desktop uses table layout with sortable headers and +/- controls. Mobile uses card-based layout with large SHOT buttons. OF+/OF- columns in GameStatsView only appear when goal events have playersOnField metadata. Access path: Events & Schedule > Past > Score button > Live Stats Entry > Start Live Stats.
